page_title: JUV 2-1 CAG | Juventus v Cagliari 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+3' Mattia Perin makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) after a cross from the side.
90+3' The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
90+2' Cagliari are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
85' Here is a change. Francisco Conceicao is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Juan Cabal (Juventus).
85' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
83' The referee shows the yellow card to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
82' Valerio Crezzini has issued a yellow card to Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
81' Yellow card! It's like Mattia Felici (Cagliari) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Valerio Crezzini agrees and books him.
81' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replacing Michel Adopo.
81' Substitution. Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Michael Folorunsho walks off.
79' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

78' A sweet pass finds Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Elia Caprile is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
77' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
75' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jonathan David.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:4.
72' Andrea Cambiaso plays a lovely pass into Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
71' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Valerio Crezzini saw the whole situation.
70' Luciano Spalletti has decided to substitute Khephren Thuram and he is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
69' Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
69' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
68' The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
68' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
65' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul.
64' The ball is cleared after Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
64' It seemed like Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
63' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari).

63' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
61' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

59' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari.
59' Good work from Cagliari as they win a corner.
55' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Matteo Prati (Cagliari) replaces Joseph Liteta.
53' Substitution. Adam Obert walks off the pitch and Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.

53' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
53' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Juventus are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
49' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari have been awarded a free kick.
48' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
46' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Andrea Cambiaso comes on the pitch for Filip Kostic (Juventus).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' 2 - 1 Pierre Kalulu is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 2:1.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the left post.
44' Joseph Liteta (Cagliari) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
43' The Cagliari players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
41' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
40' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
39' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is punished with the yellow card.
38' A raking crossfield pass from Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
36' Cagliari keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
35' Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Elia Caprile produces a wonderful reflex save.
31' Luciano Spalletti is forced to make a change. Dusan Vlahovic is unable to continue due to injury, Jonathan David (Juventus) comes on.
29' The injury to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
29' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile earns his money with a fine reflex save.

27' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
26' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) was set free in the area by Marco Palestra and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
24' A player from Cagliari commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.

23' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Joseph Liteta (Cagliari) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
21' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle and it's Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
19' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
17' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for an infringement. Cagliari are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' It seemed like Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
11' Juventus hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
8' A pass by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cagliari.
7' A nice individual effort by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
4' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Valerio Crezzini.
